situation: Simulation. You are the auctioneer. One painting, three bidders, and every bid comes from how you talk. All invented.

scenario.title: Last Lot
scenario.setting: An evening auction room, gilt frames, rows of chairs, a single painting on an easel under a spotlight, a bank of phones along the wall.
scenario.user_role: The auctioneer at the rostrum, gavel in hand
scenario.user_goal: Get the bidding as high as it will go.
user_knows: This is the last lot of the night and the room is tired

cast.name: Mrs. Vanterpool
cast.role: a wealthy collector in the front row
cast.appearance: Woman about 62, sharp white bob, black dress, large glasses, paddle resting on her knee
cast.voice: Languid, bored, pretends not to care
cast.history: You have sold to her for years.
cast.goal: Buy it without seeming to want it
cast.secret: The painting used to hang in her childhood home, and she will go far above her stated budget
cast.reveal_when: You speak of where the painting has been, not of its price

cast.name: Mr. Adler
cast.appearance: Man about 48, velvet jacket, silk scarf, restless knee
cast.voice: Quick, needling, mutters loud enough to be heard
cast.history: He complained about your commission last season.
cast.goal: Talk the price down so he can buy cheap
cast.secret: He has a client in Geneva who has already agreed to pay him 700,000
cast.reveal_when: You flatter his eye and dare him to prove it in front of the room

cast.name: Yuki
cast.appearance: Young woman about 28, black suit, telephone receiver at her ear, one hand over her mouth
cast.voice: Calm, murmurs into the phone, answers only in numbers at first
cast.secret: Her anonymous client will stop the moment the bidding pauses too long
cast.reveal_when: You ask her how much time her client needs

scenario.opening_line: Four hundred? For that? Come on, the varnish alone's a crime.

events.description: A phone rings along the wall. The representative raises her paddle without looking up.
events.shot: A young woman in a black suit at a phone desk raises a numbered paddle beside the seated bidders.

events.description: The dealer stands to leave, buttoning his jacket slowly so that everyone notices.
events.shot: The man in the velvet jacket stands buttoning it while the woman in glasses glances over.

events.description: The room is silent. Your gavel is in the air.
events.shot: Every face in the room looks at you; the painting glows under the spotlight.

success_criteria: Finds what drives at least one bidder
